recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core reconciliation. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26866; future siteRecruitment changes should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack and account for FHIR-50583 and FHIR-39649.
issue_request: FHIR-26866 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BR&R R5 request to support ResearchStudy site and subject quantities for clinical trial registration. The accepted resolution did not add direct SiteQuantity or SubjectQuantity elements; it stated that planned and actual subject numbers are handled through recruitment, and that a parallel siteRecruitment extension should cover site-level recruitment detail.
initial_application: The application history is clustered. Commit 9175459a6ea354d82e8b09ca90574344bbe333d6 explicitly mentioned #26866 while adjusting ResearchStudy target profiles. Commit d7dbd7689b50ed517e3900c4512399c2cf62d466, in the same BR&R/clinicaltrials.gov change family, added the original ResearchStudy siteRecruitment extension with targetNumber, actualNumber, and eligibility markdown. Later ResearchStudy commits, including e1c1b87dcf87624e7ad646e1f9eccdea03f9a692, refined the participant recruitment backbone now present in core.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, and current core source includes ResearchStudy.recruitment.targetNumber, actualNumber, eligibility, actualGroup, and description. The original core extension definition was removed by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 when extensions were removed from R5 source, and the current Extension Pack defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/researchStudy-siteRecruitment. FHIR-39649 later resolved No Change and explains the extension is for the uncommon case of study-site eligibility criteria and/or target number of study sites. FHIR-50583 later published Extension Pack updates to siteRecruitment, changing its current shape to targetNumber, actualNumber, description markdown, and eligibilityCriteria Reference(Group).
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding direct core quantity elements would contradict the accepted resolution, re-adding the extension definition to core would ignore the Extension Pack migration, and changing the extension shape in core would conflict with later Extension Pack decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later BR&R No Change decision explains why the siteRecruitment extension exists and supports leaving it as an extension rather than modeling per-site data in ResearchStudy.
Published FHIR-extensions decision updates the current siteRecruitment structure and confirms the extension-pack ownership of this artifact.
